inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): 7 out of 9 personnel files did not contain notary signature on the affidavit form at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not report to licensing a child being unsupervised in the 48-hour time span.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: A caregiver was witnessed on the phone while supervising children outside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver was not properly supervising a child, resulting in the child getting away with no visual or auditory proximity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Acceptable Loose-fill Surfacing: Playground loose fill  was not at sufficient depth at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Acceptable Loose-fill Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4905)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: It was found that a caregiver grabbed a child in care.  It was also found that this caregiver has grabbed multiple children on previous occasions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: It was found that a caregiver has repeatedly threatened to use prohibited punishment on children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: It was found that a caregiver yelled at a child in care.   Additionally, the caregiver has a pattern of yelling at children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation did not complete the employees who left employment survey timely
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Based on the information gathered during a DFPS investigation, it was found that a caregiver who had unsupervised access to children in care did not have a current first aid certificate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the information gathered during the course of a DFPS investigation, it was found that a caregiver did not intervene when a child was injured while rolling around in the mulch loose fill on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: Based on the information gathered during a DFPS investigation, it was found that the operation did not notify a parent of a child's injuries upon pickup.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: A caregiver was witnessed hitting a child on the leg with an open hand.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver fed a child a bottle of breast milk that did not belong to him.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: A caregiver fed a child breast milk from a bottle that was not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: The operation did not inform a parent of a situation that placed a child at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: A current gas inspection was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: A child was left in a soiled diaper and not check on long enough to develop a rash.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The operation was not documenting substitutions to the daily menu.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions (26 TAC §746.3313(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two child files were missing the health care professional statement of health.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left unsupervised in a classroom for approximately 1 minute.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child: A child was given a food that he has a diagnosed allergy to.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §746.3301(i))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on interviews it was determined a child was left outside unattended for less than two minutes.     This was corrected at inspection when the director talked with both caregivers involved and discussed the transition policies and procedures to make sure the caregivers are following them at all times. The director reminded the caregivers to ask for assistance if needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
